standard_prerequisites.name: On affines, two objects of the derived category of modules whose derived global sections agree are isomorphic
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the commutativity to an equality of derived global sections.

standard_prerequisites.name: The Leray identity RGamma(Y, Rf_*K) = RGamma(X, K)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the equality of the derived global sections of the two composites.

core_obligations: Compare the two composites on a complex K in D(B): each is an object of D(A), and by the affine comparison it suffices to compare their derived global sections over Y (proof lines 575-576).
By the Leray identity both derived global sections agree, so the two composites are isomorphic and the square commutes (proof lines 576-577).
proof_roadmap: Reduce the commutativity to derived global sections via the affine comparison (proof lines 575-576).
Conclude by the Leray identity (proof lines 576-577).
